text: I'm happy I graduated but sad to leave my friends
it was my last day at school and I smiled but I also cried
my boyfriend broke up with me and I keep crying
I still love her but she is gone and it hurts
nobody texted me back and I cried all night
I eat lunch alone every day and it makes me feel down
our anniversary dinner felt so calm and peaceful
lying next to my partner listening to the rain feels so relaxing
looking at old photos from my childhood makes me smile
we sang the songs from high school and I was so happy remembering those days
so many deadlines this week but I won't give up
my thesis is due Friday and I'm stressed but determined to finish it
I failed my exam and I feel terrible about it
I just got promoted and I can't stop smiling
I'm so nervous about my job interview tomorrow
someone stole my bike and I'm furious
I'm angry at him but also scared of what he will do
I'm excited for the trip but nervous about flying
I'm not happy at all I'm just sad
I don't miss him and I feel happy today
